title: Starting on cornet, put on alto horn by the professor Tio; later mellophone
summary: The old professor judged the cornet too strong for him so he moved to alto horn, then mellophone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: He belonged to Auburn Band. The OBBs. Ask him did he ever play the cornet?
Well, I started... First on the cornet. Oh, you're good. But the old professor told me it was too strong for me. Mm-hmm. So he put me on the alt loop. Learning, you know?
Mm-hmm. What professor was that? Tio. Tio.
Mm-hmm. And ask him what his next instrument was after Aldo.
Well, the next thing you played was that mellophone, huh? Yeah. The next instrument you played after the alto was the mellophone? Mm-hmm. That's all you played? Mellophone.
I didn't have to play no others because that's all I can do to play with. With those, huh?
